'''Borik Sabha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] living in [[Camp Karnori]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the camp had problem with the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] raids, during one of which his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] lost her brother.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Borik Sabha appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the heroic quest "Breaking the Code" on Tatooine.
